departments.title: Departments
departments.subtitle: Your departments, and ways to join more

landing.title: Create a department or join one
landing.body: You don't belong to a department yet. Create a new one or join an existing one.
landing.createBody: Set up your department and its units. Your request is reviewed by the super admin.
landing.joinBody: Join with an invite link, or with a key and a password.

create.title: New department request
create.subtitle: Your request goes to the super admin; the department is created once approved.
create.name: Department name
create.unitsHint: Add units you already know, or add more later from the structure page.

pending.title: Your request is under review
pending.body: The super admin will review your request soon.

invite.title: Invite
invite.rotateKeyConfirm: The old link will stop working. Rotate the key?
invite.rotatePasswordConfirm: The old password will stop working. Rotate the password?
invite.approvalToggleBody: When on, new members wait for the head's approval.
invite.passwordHiddenNotice: For security, the password is shown only right after it's created or rotated.
invite.saveNowWarning: Save this now — it won't be shown again.
invite.linkDescription: Anyone who opens this link can ask to join your department.

join.title: Join a department

byForm.title: Join with a key and password

join.pendingApproval: Your request is waiting for the head's approval
join.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
join.pendingApprovalBody: The department head has been notified. You will get a notification once they approve, and can start work then.
join.approvalNotice: Joining this department needs the head’s approval.
join.successBody: The department’s work is open to you now.

members.title: Members
members.leaveConfirm: Are you sure you want to leave this department?
members.leaveBlockedHead: Transfer headship to someone else first.
members.transferConfirm: Headship will be transferred to {name}. Continue?

settings.title: Department settings
settings.name: Name
settings.permissionsDescription: Set what members can do on their own.
settings.allowSelfAssign: Members can assign themselves to units
settings.telegramGroupLabel: Who can connect a Telegram group
settings.dangerZoneDescription: Irreversible actions that affect the whole department.
settings.requestDeletionConfirm: The super admin will review this request. This cannot be undone.
settings.permissionsReadOnlyDescription: What members may do on their own in your department. Your department head manages these.

noDepartment.title: You are not in a department yet
noDepartment.body: Join with an invite link, or ask for a new department to be opened.

joinRequests.title: Join requests
joinRequests.description: People asking to join. Approve and they can start work immediately.
joinRequests.approvedToast: Approved — they are in the department now
joinRequests.undone: Request put back in the queue
joinRequests.conflict: This request has already been decided.

empty.title: No requests waiting
empty.body: A new request shows up here and in your notifications.

features.title: Capabilities
features.description: Turn on what your department needs. Anything off is hidden from everyone.
features.readOnlyDescription: What is turned on in your department. The head decides these.

custom_fields.label: Custom fields
custom_fields.description: Add your own fields to cards — a document number, a source, anything.

person_fields.label: Person fields
person_fields.description: Facts about colleagues we record ourselves — where they studied, for example.

estimates.label: Time estimates
estimates.description: Record roughly how long a piece of work takes and count it towards workload.

workload.label: Workload
workload.description: Who is how busy, week by week (head only).

dependencies.label: Dependencies
dependencies.description: Mark that one item is waiting on another, and see what is blocked.

recurring.label: Recurring work
recurring.description: Work that reopens itself every week or every month.

templates.label: Templates
templates.description: Ready-made card and project templates, so the same work is not retyped.

goals.label: Goals
goals.description: Quarterly goals and how far along they are.

focus_list.label: Focus list
focus_list.description: Up to five headline items per person.

automations.label: Automations
automations.description: Simple rules like “due date approaching — remind me”.

reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.description: A reminder about a card at a time you pick.
